desc: DAKA Bins are designed to keep loose parts, gear, ammo, and other items secure inside Hard Cases or any case outfitted with the Magpul DAKA GRID Organizer. Made from sturdy polymer and designed for rugged use with 0.1 thick walls to protect whatever is placed inside. DAKA Bins utilize transparent lids for easy contents identification, and the reinforced lid snap tabs lock securely with the Bin sides to keep them securely closed.
